mapper.select: SELECT o.ticker AS symbol, o.side AS side, o.quantity AS quantity, o.executed_price AS executedPrice, o.executed_on AS executedOn FROM orders o WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.status = 'FILLED' AND o.executed_on IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.executed_on ASC, o.order_id ASC

SELECT o.ticker AS symbol, o.side AS side, o.quantity AS quantity, o.executed_price AS executedPrice, o.executed_on AS executedOn FROM orders o WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.status = 'FILLED' AND o.executed_on IS NOT NULL AND o.executed_on >= #{executedOn} ORDER BY o.executed_on ASC, o.order_id ASC
